items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Luis Russell, he went to New York and he had a gig and he told me to come to New York, he's got a job for me.

ctx.x: Oh, that would have been in about '24 or '25.

Then I left. Luis Russell, he went to New York and he had a gig and he told me to come to New York, he's got a job for me. I tried to get Simeon to come, too. He didn't want to leave. And that's how I got to New York.
Well, after you joined Duke and then you recorded with King Oliver, who else recorded with King Oliver at that time? That was in '27 or '28.
